name: @veren/person-agent-bundle
description: Use when a DSH profile needs the Person Agent installed and composed in one step: it is a configuration-only bundle whose patch inserts the single person-agent-app row - the bridge persona, the page-scoped session/workspace tools and the renhua skill all live inside the app's page sessions, so there are no toggles; the application framework (app registry, page registry, task center, app-host) rides in through the @veren/app-host-bundle dependency, and the member plugins ship as plain dependencies without bundle declarations of their own, so this patch is the stack's only profile layer; skip it when you want to compose the app row by row in your own patch.
